title: 找回南瓜灯
sourceAuthority: scripts/halloween_home_edition_content.py; never revive the old HOME route/decoder draft
scope: New Chinese Player/Host PDFs, private final-scene print master, neutral source previews, scoped H05 Home page and existing-order/checkout language selection. Keep reviewed English bytes, other games, ClassroomC05, prices and global styles.

translation.approach: Author and cross-check fixed Chinese wording locally. No translation API needed.
translation.spatialRule: 所有人面对同一顶端；正上/正下=同列相邻，正左/正右=同行相邻。方向按玩家面对纸面的视角。

stages.title: 找回演员海报
stages.actions: 用纸观察框查看八张海报右上角，以三道折线缺口的数量和形状选出四张；允许圈选、指认或口述。
stages.localization: 保留同尺度参照，不按颜色判定，不要求拼写中文角色名。

stages.title: 制作纸演员
stages.actions: 有字面朝外对折，伙伴检查，成人沿可见半边轮廓剪透两层，保留中心连接折边，再展开。
stages.localization: 方法图使用中性爱心，明确完整图形本来就可见；这是制作对称演员，不是隐藏图案谜题。

stages.title: 一起排好舞台
stages.actions: 分别朗读四张私密位置卡，一边摆演员一边核对；四条关系都成立再交成人核准。
stages.localization: 自然表述正上方/正下方/正左方/正右方，并解释同列/同行、相邻；保留原有唯一排列。

stages.title: 翻窗排练
stages.actions: 听成人逐句读，认出或指认演员，指出其舞台位置，再开对应窗；错误关回重试，演员留在原位。
stages.localization: 四张描述卡与成人排练台词成对改写；提示卡不印角色名或窗号，排版顺序不是演出顺序。

stages.title: 南瓜灯正式演出
stages.actions: 成人私下布置结局，关窗后邀请玩家回来；按不同顺序逐个呼唤演员，正确开窗后演员移到谢幕区；最后成人移开整张窗页，展示无遮挡灯图。
stages.localization: 正式台词与同一组提示卡保持语义一致；完整结局与正确摆位只在成人指南。

pairedCueDrafts.heading: 夜空
pairedCueDrafts.card: 我倒挂着休息，天黑后飞出来。
pairedCueDrafts.rehearsal: 夜空安静下来，谁倒挂着休息、天黑后飞出来？
pairedCueDrafts.finale: 音乐响起，谁飞过了傍晚的天空？

pairedCueDrafts.heading: 老树
pairedCueDrafts.card: 我守在树枝上，用圆圆的脸望着四周。
pairedCueDrafts.rehearsal: 老树枝头，谁有圆圆的脸，正守望着四周？
pairedCueDrafts.finale: 老树上，谁一直守望着这场庆典？

pairedCueDrafts.heading: 门廊
pairedCueDrafts.card: 我有圆圆的身体和一根小柄，笑着迎接邻居。
pairedCueDrafts.rehearsal: 门廊边，谁有圆身体和小柄，笑着欢迎邻居？
pairedCueDrafts.finale: 门口，谁带着笑脸迎接每一位邻居？

pairedCueDrafts.heading: 星光
pairedCueDrafts.card: 我在高高的夜空闪亮，照着整场庆典。
pairedCueDrafts.rehearsal: 抬头看，谁在高高的夜空闪亮？
pairedCueDrafts.finale: 演出上方，谁一直闪亮，陪着皮普找回南瓜灯？

documentStructure.player: 封面、任务分工、单一进度核准表、中性观察/方向示例、中性折剪/翻窗图、五关说明及相应纸件、空白可选纪念页。
documentStructure.host: 快速开始、打印发放清单、道具/人数表、方法说明、五关引导与私用核验、逐句排练台词、不同顺序的正式台词与私用结局、每组必印的私密灯图、损坏修复/暂停重置。
documentStructure.pagination: 中文内容排不下就增页。页码引用、页面标签和打印张数以最终中文清单为准，不复制固定英文页码。
documentStructure.privateFinale: 完整灯图与正确位置不进入玩家PDF。即使指南屏幕阅读，每组也必须打印一张成人私用灯图。

participation.players: 2-6人一组，另有成人；7-12人两套独立材料。
participation.allocation: 四份模板/位置卡/提示卡：2人2/2，3人2/1/1，4人各1；5-6人搭档轮换折叠、核线、展开、指认、开窗及移演员。协调任务不限制其他持卡人发言。
participation.evidence: 圈选海报、保留演员、实际舞台和开窗操作为依据；总表只记成人核准，不重复抄答案。
participation.props: 17散件；四任务卡整页保留的少剪方式为13散件。模板变成演员不重复计数；四窗保持连接。

layout.font: Embed a dedicated Chinese font; reuse final English props and absolute geometry without changing English files.
layout.threeSheets: 同一纸型内，舞台、窗页、私密结局底图共用固定坐标和对位点；中文标题换行不得挤动窗位。A4与Letter分别验证，不混用。
layout.print: 单面、100%实际大小；黑白打印也可分辨长裁剪线与短折叠线。
layout.measurement: 逐件测量实际导出剪影包围盒与开窗尺寸，再校验叠放中心和四角对位。

outputs.sourceVersionNote: Content adapted from reviewed English1.1; retain original sourceEnglishVersion pin required by existing original retail slots (v1.0), rather than confusing this with the content-reference revision.

siteAndDelivery.page: Only H05 Home title,description,steps,pagecounts,prep and actual neutral previews; preserve existing layout/CSS.
siteAndDelivery.privacy: No solved positions,correct actor-window mapping,unfolded private clue pages,final lantern art or complete ending in public previews/bundle.
siteAndDelivery.languageSelection: Chinese checkout defaults to Chinese; English checkout defaults to English. List actual pagecounts per edition; interface and PDF language remain separate.
siteAndDelivery.oldOrders: Use existing authenticated owner/expiry/refund/version guards and current entitlements. No second purchase required when eligible existing order has the new edition available.
siteAndDelivery.flag: PAID_HALLOWEEN_HOME_EDITIONS_ENABLED defaultOFF until complete matching files verified.
siteAndDelivery.preserve: All eight existing paid bilingual game flags/editions,legacy English slots,orders,payments,prices and additive schema.
siteAndDelivery.publication: Separate later authorized step: fresh verified rollback tag,private file readback/exact manifest activation/API feature check,then matching interface.

sequence: Author complete Chinese story,action,clue,paired script and private-answer tables.
Generate Chinese font/PDFs for both papers; derive all cross-references and print totals.
Inspect every final page and independently solve actual printed clues; verify both spoken scripts and withheld ending.
Generate safe final-source preview crops and integrate only H05 Home language-aware delivery metadata.
Verify ZIP bytes,synthetic existing-order language/paper switching and unchanged existing games; produce review artifacts before any later publication.
acceptance: No English-only clue or word association is required for the Chinese version.
Four spatial relations yield exactly the original unique solution.
Each read-aloud line matches one printed description and one actor; rehearsal/finale retain distinct original orders.
No copying loops; no player answer map or full ending; private props are separately staged.
All references and per-team printing counts match actual generated files.
Actual paper geometry,font coverage/paint,greyscale marks and every page pass checks.
All four Chinese PDFs and two paired ZIPs match final manifests.
Frozen reviewed English PDF and ZIP hashes unchanged.
No real child trial or physical printing falsely claimed.
